name: Bench Dip
summary: A bodyweight triceps exercise using a bench behind you; the feet position changes how hard it is.
setup: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands next to your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight and shoulders down.
Bend the knees for an easier version or extend the legs for harder.
Keep the body close to the bench.
execution: Bend the elbows to lower the hips toward the floor, elbows pointing back.
Lower until the upper arms are around parallel to the floor; no deeper if the shoulders feel strained.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Keep the shoulders down away from the ears throughout.
mistakes: Dropping too low so shoulders roll forward: limit depth to about 90 degrees at the elbows.
Hips drifting far from the bench: keep them close.
Flaring the elbows: keep them pointing straight back.
Shrugging up: keep the shoulders depressed.
